controls.columns_shuffled: per-row: files named *_shuffled_* use a seeded shuffle (crc32 of the file name), the primary arm; *_original_* keep the released column order, the audit arm that measures order reliance (plans/x5_prereg.json)
controls.supplier: none (data only; AVICI sees the data matrix, no names)

orientation_rule: AVICI: an edge where p(i -> j) > 0.5, the larger direction kept when both pass, so no pair is left undecided; the GES and kernel v3 rows in x5_dev.json use the AB-01 expectation rule (undecided pairs at random, seed crc32(file name))

metric_defs.directed_f1: directed-edge F1 per file (score/graph.directed_f1), mean over files (x5_dev.json mean_f1)
metric_defs.paired: paired difference of per-file directed F1 against GES and kernel v3 on the same files, 95% scenario-cluster bootstrap (B = 2000, seed 20261020)
metric_defs.p: AVICI's edge-probability matrix per file (a prediction, not a score)

note: Written 20 Oct by the site chat after CI's score-contract test failed: the X5 job (sheet A) wrote results without a contract. Fields follow plans/x5_prereg.json.
